definitions.choice: The actual selection versus the highest-ranked prospect left on the public board at that exact turn.
definitions.reach: Consensus rank minus pick is positive for reaches. Unranked selections contribute only a conservative lower bound to reach counts and are omitted from typical gaps.
definitions.team_situation: Contenders won at least 60% and made the playoffs. Rebuilders won at most 42% and missed them. Shared-slot estimates weight each exact pick by the harmonic share of observations on both sides.
definitions.positional_need: A team's prior regular-season minutes by listed primary guard, wing or big compared to the same season's 30-team average for that position. Positive pick-minus-board deficit means the pick addresses a larger relative minutes deficit.
definitions.college: College class standing approximates years of college experience. Production uses final-year T-Rank college box plus-minus and points per game. Unknowns stay missing.
definitions.outcomes: Four NBA seasons from the draft, including zero minutes and zero value over replacement for seasons absent from the panel. Year-four box plus-minus requires NBA minutes. An order's concordance is its fraction of pairwise outcomes in the right order with half credit for ties.
definitions.trade: Count unique current-draft picks, not transactions. Use documented draft-day changes in rights with the date corrections in the source notes. Subsequent formal approval can occur later.

2016.publisher: CBS Sports Final NBA Draft Big Board (Sam Vecenie, 2016-06-22)

pro_basketball.notes: Compact extracts preserve the draft number, NBA biography, regular-season team stint minutes and team record. Advanced seasons 2013–2019 use the already checked-in Basketball Reference career panel, later seasons use the versioned mirror. No new requests were made to Basketball Reference.

college.notes: Existing repo caches, retained columns for candidate identity, class, birth date and final-season box production. Class is a proxy for years, especially for transfers and players with eligibility exceptions.

draft_night.notes: Draft selection tables and their trade notes identify recipient and rights moves. The annotated count is a documented count, subject to dates and incomplete early coverage. Each number counts once even when a pick moved twice.

date_adjustments.2012: Pick 55 sent to the Lakers in the draft-day notes.
date_adjustments.2016: The Taurean Prince / Jeff Teague agreement preceded the draft.
date_adjustments.2020: Pick 28 had moved in the prior Lakers/Thunder agreement; the draft-night move to Minnesota still counts.
date_adjustments.2021: Picks 10, 17, 40 were in the already agreed Memphis/New Orleans swap.
date_adjustments.2022: Pick 30 went to Denver in an earlier agreement. Pick 22 went to Minnesota on draft night before a separate July trade to Utah.
date_adjustments.2023: Picks 29 and 32 were agreed to before draft night. Pick 37 went to Denver in the preceding deal with Oklahoma City. Pick 40 changed hands again for Maxwell Lewis on draft night.
date_adjustments.2025: Pick 10 and pick 22 were tied to deals reported before draft day.

game_2026.notes: The repository's original free pre-draft prospect and ESPN order captures. October 2026 team context is used by the game to pick. The prior 2025–26 record and positional minutes classify all four game drafts for the report.

game.setup: Stock selection-only AI. The 2026 public prospect cache and pre-draft ESPN order were restored in memory on the fresh post-draft league snapshot. Future classes use projected draft order and the same starting team strategy and rosters. Evaluation uses 2025–26 standings and roster minutes for all four assignments. No season or trade execution is simulated.

tuning.method: Reach grid minimizes equal-weight differences in median absolute gap / 4, reach-5 rate / 0.15, and reach-10 rate / 0.10 in the four pick bands. Historical fit years and two generated classes choose a candidate; 2022–2025 and the third generated class are a separate check. Other weights are one-at-a-time sensitivity checks around the best reach-grid setting.
